!!! warning TS377172: This `Effect.useSpan` callback never uses the span it receives. `Effect.useSpan` does not make that span the parent of spans created inside the callback, so they will not nest under it; `Effect.withSpan` does, and removes `ParentSpan` from the requirements. effect(useSpanUnusedSpanToWithSpan)
